Airport Clear Zone
The County announced recently a proposal for future expansion of Mitchell Field. This proposal is for acquisition of 12 acres in 1972 and another 12 acres in 1973 for a clear zone on the north side of the airport.
The boundaries are basically Layton Avenue on the south, Brust Avenue on the west, Whitnall Avenue on the north and the alley east of Kansas Street as the east boundary. This area encompasses about 64 homes.
This project is subject to various approvals, including County Board, budget, environmental impact, relocation plan, etc. and is noted here at this time for informational purposes only.
Analysis of the aforementioned facts indicates minimal concurrent displacement activity. Accordingly, competition for housing for the displacees from the Airport Spur project should not be a factor unless existing policy requirements change drastically and within a short period of time as they affect the Stadium and Lake Freeway projects. This likelihood however is not contemplated at this time or over the previously mentioned displacement period.
ADMINISTRATION 
This Plan as detailed herein will be administered by the Department of Transportation, Division of Highways, District #9 Relocation Unit Staff. The relocation unit staff consists of six relocation agents who will deal directly and personally with each relocatee; one housing technician and a payments' computation and review agent, plus a unit supervisor. Two of the relocation agents are well qualified to attend to social and financial problems which may be encountered. Also, liaison has been established with numerous social help agencies,
